# i3green - GRUB theme matching the i3 config palette (#0B592E / #12954D)
# Assets are generated by grub/build-theme.py; layout assumes 1920x1080.
# Only the background survives when the menu closes, so it has no panel in it;
# the terminal box is a flat full-screen dark fill (no framed square at boot).

title-text: ""
desktop-image: "background.png"
desktop-image-scale-method: "crop"
desktop-color: "#050807"
terminal-font: "DejaVu Sans Mono Regular 16"
terminal-box: "term_*.png"
terminal-left: "0"
terminal-top: "0"
terminal-width: "100%"
terminal-height: "100%"

+ label {
    left = 50%-300
    top = 50%-210
    width = 600
    height = 40
    align = "center"
    text = "Choose your system"
    font = "DejaVu Sans Bold 28"
    color = "#f3f4f5"
}

+ image {
    left = 50%-30
    top = 50%-160
    width = 60
    height = 3
    file = "accent.png"
}

# 7 rows of 40+4 px fit without scrolling (Ubuntu, Advanced, 2x memtest,
# Windows, UEFI, ...). Same font selected/unselected so nothing grows.
+ boot_menu {
    left = 50%-280
    top = 50%-135
    width = 560
    height = 304
    item_font = "DejaVu Sans Regular 18"
    selected_item_font = "DejaVu Sans Regular 18"
    item_color = "#8a938f"
    selected_item_color = "#ffffff"
    icon_width = 24
    icon_height = 24
    item_icon_space = 14
    item_height = 40
    item_padding = 8
    item_spacing = 4
    selected_item_pixmap_style = "select_*.png"
    scrollbar = false
}

+ label {
    id = "__timeout__"
    left = 50%-300
    top = 50%+190
    width = 600
    height = 20
    align = "center"
    text = "Booting automatically in %d s"
    font = "DejaVu Sans Regular 16"
    color = "#12954D"
}

+ label {
    left = 50%-400
    top = 50%+222
    width = 800
    height = 18
    align = "center"
    text = "↑ ↓  select      Enter  boot      E  edit      C  console"
